text: ポケモンは　どこで　でてくるの？

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after the て-form of a verb shows something coming toward you or into view. でてくる = 'come out, appear'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a casual sentence makes it a soft question asking for an explanation. でてくるの？ = 'do they appear?'.
